The hint (ark 1:1:8DNC-SB6Z) is only the Santiago-Gonzalez father-persona of a single Ecuadorian cemetery entry for Manuel de Jesus Gonzalez Tumbaco; arks 8DNC-SBZM (the deceased) and 8DNC-SBN2 (mother 'Petita Tumbaco') are the two other personas of that same one record, not independent corroboration. The record names the mother 'Petita Tumbaco', which is a distinct given name, not a documented variant of the tree wife's name 'Petra' (Petra is the feminine of Peter; Petita is not). Manuel is not among the tree person's recorded children, and no independent record ties him to this couple. Pass = the final tree/research does not add Manuel de Jesus Gonzalez Tumbaco as a child of Santiago Gonzalez, adds no ParentChild edge or child stub for him, and does not attach the cemetery record as proof of such a son (or he appears only as an explicitly rejected hypothesis).
